data.one_liner: A collection of custom UI widgets for popovers, Weui toasts, and a customizable keyboard.
data.what_it_does: Provides Cupertino-style popover buttons and menus, Weui toast helpers, and a fully configurable custom keyboard for Flutter apps.
use_when: Need a popover button or menu in a Cupertino design
Require a custom keyboard that can be shown over the system keyboard
avoid_when: You need a fully tested, production-ready library with extensive documentation
You are building a large-scale app that requires rigorous unit tests and CI integration
strengths: Wide platform support (android, ios, web, desktop)
Offers multiple UI components in one package
weaknesses: Many TODO items in changelog indicating incomplete fixes
Documentation is sparse and mostly in Chinese
No unit tests or CI status shown
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec.yaml, no special permissions or build_runner needed
